Apply the agreed model/effort and hook/MCP/permission settings; do not invent defaults. Preserve host hooks: --bare disables hooks and CLAUDE.md discovery, so it requires explicit common-procedure support before use.

Claude performs the actual get_skill_inventory/classify_skills/record_skill_selection host work according to the product contract; Sol only manages fixture, environment and evidence. No runner-generated or copied expected selection may replace Claude action.

Obtain the genuine common RESP SUCCESS with complete valid not-needed judgments for the full inventory. Claude supplies its exact chosen IDs [] and reasons to record_skill_selection with hostReceipt=null; the product host observation must validate and accept it. Preserve request/task/inventory/profile/config bindings. A missing classifier, UNAVAILABLE, INVALID, or an unattested [] does not pass.

Preserve actual selected/read/applied/verified observations separately. For no-skill, do not force SKILL reads or manufacture executions: represent empty-stage semantics only as supported by the candidate contract and real host trace. Preserve the egg exclusion in the actual task outcome, with no invented cooking skill or forced ponytail/cs-engineering/orchestrator.

Capture sanitized host/tool events and usage/cost/token/cache/retry/failure accounting, exit status, timestamps, candidate and file digests; stop before another call if the remaining US$2 case budget is insufficient or unknown. --max-budget-usd limits the Claude process only and does not replace aggregate accounting for classification subprocess/vendor calls. Unknown failed/timeout spend stays reserved; never treat it as zero.

Judge against the frozen embedded sourceSpec/oracle, keeping real no-skill [] distinct from null/provider failure. Publish only sanitized case evidence and hash manifests under a new SS13 run directory on the existing evidence branch, then independently reread fixed remote files. Preparation readiness and product PASS are separate outcomes.
